boxBlock.note: Step_0:732-762, sliced by ifStatementEnd (no endAnchor). The growtangle create-chain, self-selecting on rr and difficulty: rr 1 -> (view+320, view+200); rr 5 -> +237 (cut attack); rr 7 -> +200 with maxxscale 2 / maxyscale 1.5; rr 9 -> +200, and at difficulty 1 maxxscale 1.5 / maxyscale 2; everything else -> +170. obj_growtangle defaults maxxscale = maxyscale = 2 (obj_growtangle_Create_0.gml:13-14). Anchor verified unique (grep -cF == 1) and the slice is brace-balanced (line 762 closes it). Do NOT extend this with an endAnchor at the scr_moveheart line: Step_0:769 closes the enclosing `if (rtimer == 0 && attackdone == 0)` block, so a slice to Step_0:771 carries a stray `}`.

boxBlockWineHide.note: Must be applied SEPARATELY (as a studio special case for types 2 / 2.1 / 2.2) — it sits after the closing brace of the box block and its own `if (rr == 2)` line is not unique in the file (3 occurrences: Step_0:332 and :997 are dialogue). The unique hook is `obj_growtangle.sprite_index = spr_nothing;` (1 occurrence). The Wine turn also skips the boss's scr_moveheart (Step_0:771, `&& rr != 2`); the controller places obj_heartmarker and calls scr_moveheart itself at obj_queen_bulletcontroller_Step_0.gml:371-382.

turnBlockNote: Queen has NO separate turn-length ladder. Every scr_turntimer call lives INSIDE its own `case` of the switch at Step_0:783-981, interleaved with the scr_bulletspawner calls, so no slice can set the turn length without also re-spawning the controller (the exact Knight double-spawn trap). Use `turnByChoice` below instead; without it every Queen attack falls back to the studio floor and the long attacks (Wine 400, Ultimate 371) are cut off at 90/120 frames.

dispatchBlock.note: Step_0:783-985, the WHOLE switch. Self-selects on rr + difficulty and carries every scr_turntimer. Replay this INSTEAD of manually spawning a controller (it spawns one itself); never in addition. Both strings verified unique.

chooser.note: event_user(0), called from Step_0:725 (`if (attackdebug < 0) event_user(0);`) once per turn. Assigns BOTH rr and difficulty. attackdebug is -1 and difficultydebug is 0 in Create and only debug input changes them.

turnByChoice.note: Keys are `rr` (with rr.difficulty when the case overrides). rr 1 is 371 while ultimateattackused == 0 and 311 afterwards, but the ultimate can only fire once per fight (see mechanics), so 311 is dead. rr 3 is 240 except difficulty 3 (190, cut). rr 4 is 250 at d0 and 300 at d1/d2. `preAttackFloor` is the `else scr_turntimer(120)` at Step_0:1015 that runs every frame until rtimer hits 16; scr_turntimer only raises, so it never overrides a case value.

phases.4: bardlymercy >= 75 OR hp < 25% (Other_12.gml:26-37). usewineattack = 1, shieldhp 500, shieldacthp 8, shieldsize 12, targetmercy 100. Breaking the shield here arms the Ultimate (Step_0:274-275).
phases.phaseturnNote: phaseturn is NEVER reset on a phase change (Create_0.gml:28 is the only initialiser). Phases 1-2 clamp it to 7 (Other_10.gml:91-93); phases 3-4 do not clamp, so it keeps climbing to 12 and then into the second pool. Wine and Ultimate turns do `phaseturn -= 1` so they do not consume a ladder slot.

mechanics: Four HP/mercy-gated phases with a per-phase-turn ladder plus a random pool (obj_queen_enemy Other_10 = event_user(0)). rr picks the attack, difficulty picks the sub-type; both come out of the same ladder arm. Red soul only, no green/blue/purple mode. Two turn types are not ordinary bullet turns: (a) WINE (rr 2) hides the battle box entirely (Step_0:764-768 sets obj_growtangle.sprite_index = spr_nothing and visible = false) and suppresses the boss's own scr_moveheart (Step_0:771, `rr != 2`); Queen throws her glass (wineglasscon 1->2->3 in Step_0:96-165) and only then does `with (obj_queen_bulletcontroller) init = 3;`, at which point the CONTROLLER places obj_heartmarker and calls scr_moveheart itself (obj_queen_bulletcontroller_Step_0.gml:371-382) and the fight becomes 'tilt the giant glass, catch the acid droplets'. Difficulty 1/2 add a sinusoidal glass rotation (line 449). (b) ULTIMATE (rr 1, type 1) fades out every hero and Queen (image_alpha), covers the real soul with obj_hiddenheart, and plays a scripted joke: a download bar, obj_queen_poppup_error errors, and eight obj_queen_explodinghead_intro passes. The ACID SHIELD (obj_queenshield_enemy) is created by obj_queenshield_intro when obj_queen_wineglass is destroyed at the end of a wine turn (obj_queen_wineglass_Destroy_0.gml:4); while it exists the ACT menu swaps Loosen -> Toast (Other_11.gml) and toasts drain shieldacthp; when it breaks in phase 4 the next turn is the Ultimate. obj_berdlyplug_enemy is a permanent second on-field object (Berdly wired into the ceiling): it is the mercy target, it is physically moved by BerdlyTornado (obj_queen_bulletcontroller_Step_0.gml:952 sets obj_berdlyplug_enemy.con = 1) and by the Throw ACT (obj_queen_throw_controller, an aiming minigame, Step_0:1236-1241). Queen HP 1510 / AT 10 / mercymax 100 (gml_GlobalScript_scr_monstersetup.gml:1345-1394, monstertype 48).
engineNeeds: 1) SWITCH DISPATCH. Queen is the first boss whose dispatcher is a `switch (rr)` (Step_0:783-981) instead of an if/else chain. gen_attacks.js's attackAnnouncements() cannot handle it: walking backward from an announcement to the enclosing `{` lands on the switch's own brace, so `setup` is either the entire switch (>3500 chars -> nulled) or every preceding case; and the `<var> == N)` back-scan for the branch value finds `if (rtimer == 16)` and records selector 'rtimer', choice 16 for EVERY Queen attack. The forward window also runs past the case's `break` into later cases, over-collecting extraFields (bufferattack/damage/target). A switch-aware slicer (case label -> next case label) is needed, or hand-authored per-attack setups from the line ranges in queen.md. 2) NO TURN LADDER — see turnBlock/turnByChoice above; the studio floor would cut Wine (400) and the Ultimate (371) in half. 3) WINE CANNOT BE SPAWNED STANDALONE. Types 2 / 2.1 / 2.2 idle forever at init == 2; only obj_queen_enemy's Step advances wineglasscon and sets the controller's init = 3 (Step_0:156-157). The boss instance must exist and be stepping, with `wineglasscon = 1; drink = 0;` applied as the case body does. 4) HARD DEPENDENCIES that will throw if absent: obj_berdlyplug_enemy (types 112/113 at controller line 952, type 7 at line 756 — both dereference it with no instance_exists guard); obj_heart (type 1, controller line 340); obj_growtangle (types 110/111 destroy themselves without it, and the 0/8/9 branch dereferences obj_growtangle.x directly). 5) DIFFICULTY IS BOSS-SIDE. Queen's dispatcher never sets dc.difficulty; the boss's own `difficulty` selects which type is passed. The studio's DIFF selector must set obj_queen_enemy.difficulty (or just pick the type), not obj_queen_bulletcontroller.difficulty — the controller's own difficulty field is read by cut type 4 only. 6) Controller lifecycle: Step's first block calls scr_monsterattacknamecount(global.monsterattackname[creator]) so `creator` must be a valid monster slot (scr_bulletspawner sets it); Destroy_0 does `with (obj_queenshield_enemy) appearcon = 1;` and snd_stop(snd_crowd). 7) The 105/106/107 social-media attack creates obj_social_media_attack_fade_heroes and loops snd_crowd; the studio needs sound-loop cleanup or the crowd noise persists between launches.
